facts.fact: Carolynne Wong was hired to join StackAdapt's Creative Strategy team in 2019, her first experience working in adtech.
facts.quote: I was hired to join StackAdapt’s Creative Strategy team back in 2019. It was my first experience working in adtech.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's Creative Studio has three team leads, according to Carolynne Wong.
facts.quote: I am one of three team leads from the [Creative Studio](https://www.stackadapt.com/our-solutions/creative-studio/)!

facts.fact: StackAdapt's Creative Studio team started as a group of 5 people in the company's Toronto office.
facts.quote: I started on the Creative Studio team when we were just a group of 5 people in our Toronto office.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt, its Creative Studio team has grown to over 40 members across global locations.
facts.quote: Now we’ve expanded globally and our team has grown to over 40 members!
